symptom: `mxcli version` fails with `unknown command "version" for "mxcli"` while `mxcli --version` works
cause: cobra's `Version:` field registers only the --version flag; no subcommand existed, though shouldSuppressWarning already listed a `version` argument
fix: Add a `version` subcommand (cmd/mxcli/cmd_version.go) printing exactly cobra's --version text (name, version, build time)
insight: Code that special-cases an argument (warning suppression) is evidence of an intended command; a test pinning the subcommand output to the flag output keeps the two from drifting
